$description: Live snapshot of Figma's COLOR MODE collection (file uWlcofRor5Dik8LBnJbIjo, VariableCollectionId:10:11, modes Light / On dark surface, node 7579-50) — Figma's semantic-token equivalent, cross-referenced against src/semantic-tokens.ts (semanticColors + semanticDarkOverrides). Regenerate periodically via the Figma Desktop Bridge (figma_get_variables, collection=COLOR MODE, resolveAliases=true) — does not auto-refresh. Companion to figma-variable-map.json (the primitives-tier snapshot, captured 2026-09-02) and scripts/check-figma-semantic-drift.js. Full findings, methodology, and recommendations: docs/FIGMA_SEMANTIC_TOKEN_ASSESSMENT.md.
snapshotSource: figma-console-local MCP (Desktop Bridge), figma_get_variables, collection=COLOR MODE, resolveAliases=true, verbosity=standard, 2 pages (161 variables total, 141 transcribed — 19 Charts/Qualitative+Sequential variables and 1 decorative Stripes variable excluded, see report)
methodologyNote: The MCP's resolvedValuesByMode flattens incorrectly for any variable whose Light and 'On dark surface' mode slots reference the SAME intermediate alias variable (a common Figma authoring pattern in this file) — it echoes one mode's value for both instead of cascading the alias's own per-mode value. Of the 141 transcribed variables, 44 (31%) needed manual correction for this. See docs/FIGMA_SEMANTIC_TOKEN_ASSESSMENT.md for the full methodology and worked examples (e.g. V3/Text & icon/Primary was reported as #000F47 for both modes; the corrected dark value, cascading through V3/BASE/Brand/Primary, is #CEECFF).
mappingScope: This pass maps the 21 highest-confidence conceptual matches (brand identity, core text/surface/border, primary/secondary interactive base states, status colors) rather than force-mapping all 67 semanticColors keys — MDS's granular hover/active/visited/disabled states and Figma's richer Interaction taxonomy (~30 variables) don't have a clean 1:1 naming correspondence without design input. See the report's 'Not yet mapped' section for what's excluded and why.
